items.title: CAH Q3 CY2026 deep dive: specialty growth and contract renewals drive guidance increase
items.summary: Healthcare distributor and services company Cardinal Health (NYSE:CAH) reported calendar Q3 2026 (fiscal Q1 2027) results topping the market’s revenue expectations, with sales up 5.5% year on year to $67.51 billion. Its non-GAAP profit of $3.26 per share was 10.9% above analysts’ consensus estimates.
